forbidden_inputs: qa.gold_inds or mapped gold candidate ids
frozen_metrics: v44 and v45 target-cardinality equality rate
v44 final-set retention rate of the highest feasible cross-encoder anchor
v44 first-selected-candidate equality rate with that anchor
configuration counts by budget and target cardinality
all preceding rates repeated by budget and target cardinality

interpretation_rules.all_ordered_selections_equal: The explicit v45 anchor operation is behaviorally redundant with v44 on the frozen FinQA score cache; this explains zero metric delta but does not prove general redundancy.
interpretation_rules.sets_equal_but_orders_differ: The two selectors choose the same evidence sets but traverse them differently; set-valued metrics cannot detect the ordering difference.
interpretation_rules.some_sets_differ: The zero aggregate metric delta is coincidental at the locked endpoint and cannot be attributed to selector equivalence.
